headline: Niger State-backed NCNI opens N70 billion bond offer offering 24% yield
summary: North Central Nigeria Investment (NCNI) Plc opened a 10-year fixed-rate bond offer to raise up to N70 billion at a 24% annual yield, backed by the Niger State government.
why: Sub-national bond issuances in Nigeria provide infrastructure financing supported by state revenue allocations.

impacts.name: Nigerian Local Sovereign Debt
impacts.why: High coupon yields attract local institutional fixed-income allocations.
